description: Culinary recipe layout: ingredients checklist on left and sequential preparation instructions on right.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Culinary Recipe Steps: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
